fields.scenario: A user needs to edit a budget spreadsheet. Which software layer directly performs that user task?
fields.answer: Spreadsheet application

items.detail: An application performs the user-facing task; the OS supplies shared services. Drivers connect the OS to hardware; a filesystem organizes stored data.
items.hook: Transfer: Change the symptom to missing device support. Which layer should you investigate?

fields.scenario: A Chromebook must edit a prepared document while disconnected. Which statement is accurate?
fields.answer: Offline-capable apps and locally available files can work without an active connection

items.detail: ChromeOS supports offline-capable applications and prepared local data. Offline availability depends on the app and file configuration; Linux has roles beyond desktops.
items.hook: Transfer: Identify what must be prepared before taking a cloud document offline.

answer: Every cloud file is automatically available offline

fields.scenario: In a compiled application workflow, what is the human-readable input translated into executable code?
fields.answer: Source code

items.detail: Source code is input to compilation in this workflow. Calling source code precompiled machine instructions confuses the input with the output.
items.hook: Transfer: How does an interpreted script differ from this simplified compiled workflow?

fields.scenario: Which category best describes Android as used on a smartphone?
fields.answer: Mobile operating system

items.detail: Android is a mobile operating system in the smartphone scenario. An OS category does not imply that every application or feature requires cloud access.
items.hook: Transfer: Contrast the support needs of a mobile OS with a server workload.

fields.scenario: A lab machine must evaluate pre-release Windows features through Microsoft’s preview program. Which program fits?
fields.answer: Windows Insider Program

items.detail: Windows Insider distributes preview builds for evaluation. Preview channels and eligibility change; use current guidance and keep a recovery plan instead of old Windows servicing names.
items.hook: Transfer: Would the same risk be appropriate for a critical production workstation? Explain.

answer: A promise that all preview builds are production-safe

fields.scenario: Before capturing a reusable supported Windows reference image, which tool removes machine-specific information?
fields.answer: Sysprep with /generalize

items.detail: Sysprep /generalize prepares a reference installation by removing machine-specific information. A WIM is an image format; capture and deployment are separate operations. Use supported imaging procedures.
items.hook: Transfer: Place generalization, offline capture and target deployment in order.

answer: Copying only the user Desktop folder

fields.scenario: Where does Windows store configuration that identifies the operating-system boot entries?
fields.answer: Boot Configuration Data (BCD) store

items.detail: BCD holds Windows boot configuration used by the boot manager. UEFI and legacy boot components differ; hibernation resume is not the same as a normal OS boot.
items.hook: Transfer: Which evidence would distinguish a missing boot entry from an application startup failure?

fields.scenario: A Windows 11 procedure specifically requires the Settings app. Where should the technician edit a supported adapter’s IP assignment?
fields.answer: Settings → Network & internet → the adapter’s IP settings

items.detail: Windows network Settings can configure manual IP assignment for an adapter. Adapter properties reached through Control Panel can also configure IP; a question must constrain the path if only one answer is intended.
items.hook: Transfer: List the IP, mask/prefix, gateway and DNS information you would verify after the change.

fields.scenario: Which description of ext4 avoids overstating its fragmentation behavior?
fields.answer: Its allocation strategies reduce fragmentation, but fragmentation can still occur

items.detail: ext4 uses allocation strategies to improve data locality and reduce fragmentation. These mechanisms are not a guarantee of automatic, continuous defragmentation.
items.hook: Transfer: Explain why avoiding fragmentation is different from guaranteeing contiguous storage.

answer: It cannot store files larger than a single disk block
It guarantees that every file is always contiguous
It automatically moves every file after each read

fields.scenario: On a current supported Mac, which interface is intended for operating-system updates?
fields.answer: System Settings → General → Software Update

items.detail: Current macOS updates are offered through Software Update in System Settings. App Store app updates are a different task; older macOS versions may use different paths.
items.hook: Transfer: What compatibility and backup checks belong before a major upgrade?

answer: Only an App Store application-update list

fields.scenario: Which macOS interface would you normally use to browse folders and move a document?
fields.answer: Finder

items.detail: Finder is the standard macOS file-browsing interface. Browsing a file is different from installing an OS update or managing firmware.
items.hook: Transfer: Choose a different macOS tool to inspect a process that consumes excessive CPU.

fields.scenario: A Linux technician must search file contents under ./logs for the text timeout, including subdirectories. Which command fits?
fields.answer: grep -r timeout ./logs

items.detail: grep -r searches matching text through files recursively. find traverses directories by default; -name matches entry names rather than searching each file’s contents.
items.hook: Transfer: Change the requirement to finding files whose names end in .log. Which tool and predicate fit?

fields.scenario: Logs show repeated attempts to authenticate using many candidate passwords against one account. Which attack behavior is most directly shown?
fields.answer: Password guessing

items.detail: Repeated candidate-password attempts are evidence of password guessing. The log does not by itself prove successful access. Investigate outcomes and apply approved authentication protections.
items.hook: Transfer: What additional evidence would establish that an account was compromised?

fields.scenario: Which example uses a biometric characteristic?
fields.answer: Fingerprint recognition

items.detail: A fingerprint is a biometric characteristic. A PIN and password are both knowledge factors; a smart card/token is possession, not a biological characteristic.
items.hook: Transfer: Why do two passwords not automatically provide two different authentication factors?

fields.scenario: A malicious component alters system behavior to hide its presence from ordinary inspection. Which malware category fits?
fields.answer: Rootkit

items.detail: A rootkit is associated with concealed malicious presence or control. A symptom is a clue, not proof; follow the incident workflow and use trusted inspection/recovery methods.
items.hook: Transfer: Why might recovery from trusted media be needed when the running OS cannot be trusted?

answer: A legitimate spreadsheet macro by definition

fields.scenario: Which control creates a physical perimeter that discourages unauthorized entry to a facility?
fields.answer: A perimeter fence

items.detail: A fence creates a physical perimeter control. Physical controls complement authentication and monitoring; a fence alone does not grant or verify digital access.
items.hook: Transfer: What control would verify identity at the building entrance?

fields.scenario: What claim can safely be made about a properly used metal detector?
fields.answer: It can detect relevant metal objects within its operating limits

items.detail: A metal detector detects metal under its operating conditions. It is not a universal weapon detector or a substitute for identity checks.
items.hook: Transfer: Name a risk this physical control does not address.

fields.scenario: A deleted cloud-synced file disappears from a second device. What does this illustrate?
fields.answer: Synchronization can propagate deletions, so recovery needs separate retention/version or backup controls

items.detail: Synchronization coordinates selected data and may propagate deletion. Recoverability depends on retention, versioning and backup configuration, not merely having two synced devices.
items.hook: Transfer: How would you verify that a deleted test file can actually be recovered?

answer: A synced folder cannot be changed by its owner
Synchronization always preserves an immutable copy

fields.scenario: A technician must create a scoped inbound Windows firewall rule. Which interface is appropriate?
fields.answer: Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security

items.detail: Advanced Security manages scoped firewall rules. Defender Tamper Protection restricts unauthorized security-setting changes; it is not the tool for authoring firewall rules.
items.hook: Transfer: Which profile, program, source and port restrictions should you verify before enabling a rule?

fields.scenario: Which plan provides a stronger workstation baseline than simply renaming an administrator account?
fields.answer: Supported updates, least privilege, strong authentication and controlled administrative access

items.detail: Hardening combines maintained software with restricted access and appropriate authentication. Renaming an account alone does not prevent compromise; disabling protective controls weakens the baseline.
items.hook: Transfer: How would you verify that normal users can work without unnecessary administrator rights?

answer: Disable the host firewall on all profiles

fields.scenario: On a supported Windows edition with NTFS, a user needs file-level encryption for selected files. Which feature matches that scope?
fields.answer: Encrypting File System (EFS)

items.detail: EFS provides file-level encryption on supported Windows/NTFS configurations. Do not rule out BitLocker solely because a TPM is absent: supported non-TPM configurations exist. Plan recovery of encryption credentials.
items.hook: Transfer: When would volume-level BitLocker be the better match than EFS?

answer: FileVault for the Windows NTFS files

fields.scenario: After signing into Windows with a Microsoft account, what should a technician verify before claiming Desktop files are backed up by OneDrive?
fields.answer: The OneDrive account, selected folders, backup configuration and sync/backup status

items.detail: OneDrive folder backup requires the relevant client, account and folder configuration. A Microsoft account alone is not evidence that every file or folder is protected.
items.hook: Transfer: Create a harmless test file and describe how you would confirm upload and recovery.

answer: Assume backup succeeds when the client shows an error
Assume account sign-in alone proves every folder is protected
Assume files on every disk are included

fields.scenario: A Windows system has a supported WDDM driver. Which built-in tool can display GPU performance data?
fields.answer: Task Manager

items.detail: Task Manager can display GPU data with supported hardware and drivers. Third-party tools may add detail, but they are not always required. GPU support depends on the driver model.
items.hook: Transfer: What would you check if the GPU graph is absent?

answer: Only a third-party utility in every case

fields.scenario: After remediation, recovery validation and the required protection/update steps, what completes the user-facing malware-removal workflow?
fields.answer: Educate the end user about avoiding recurrence

items.detail: End-user education helps prevent recurrence after the required remediation and recovery steps. Education is not a substitute for containment, removal, validation or the organization’s incident procedure.
items.hook: Transfer: Change the case to an organization-managed device. Who must approve recovery and communication?

answer: Delete all incident evidence without policy approval

fields.scenario: A nearby client supports 5 GHz and measurements identify 2.4 GHz interference. Which change is reasonable to test?
fields.answer: Move the client to an appropriately configured 5 GHz connection and remeasure

items.detail: An alternative supported band may reduce the measured 2.4 GHz interference. Range, obstructions and coverage still matter; 5 GHz is not a universal cure for disconnections.
items.hook: Transfer: What changes if the client is at the edge of coverage rather than near the AP?

answer: Reduce AP power without checking coverage
Assume 5 GHz always has longer range
Shorten the SSID as a guaranteed RF fix

fields.scenario: Controller-resource errors occur when several devices share one USB controller. Which investigation is most useful?
fields.answer: Check topology and move a device to a suitable port on a different controller, then retest

items.detail: USB devices can share controller resources even across different physical ports. Check power, bandwidth, controller topology and supported drivers; port generation/color alone does not establish the cause.
items.hook: Transfer: What evidence would instead suggest a power-budget problem?

answer: Manually increase current beyond the port specification
Assume connector color proves the controller topology

fields.scenario: A Windows VM resumes after being paused and its clock is wrong. Which response addresses time synchronization appropriately?
fields.answer: Check supported host/guest time integration and the guest’s configured time hierarchy

items.detail: Virtual timekeeping and pause/resume behavior can cause clock drift. The correct time source depends on the configuration; domain members commonly use the domain hierarchy.
items.hook: Transfer: Why can an inaccurate clock affect authentication and log correlation?

answer: Set an arbitrary clock once and never monitor it
Assume every Windows guest must always use time.windows.com

fields.scenario: Which tool is intended to inspect a Windows service and restart it when authorized?
fields.answer: Services (services.msc), also available through Computer Management

items.detail: The Services management console controls supported service operations. Review dependencies and the failure cause; changing startup settings is different from restarting a running service.
items.hook: Transfer: What would you record if the service stops again immediately?

fields.scenario: A device has an overheating, visibly damaged lithium-ion battery. Which concern takes priority?
fields.answer: Thermal runaway, fire or related injury risk

items.detail: A damaged or overheated lithium-ion battery can present a serious thermal hazard. Follow manufacturer and workplace handling/escalation guidance; do not puncture, charge or improvise a repair.
items.hook: Transfer: Which approved channel handles safe isolation and disposal in your workplace?

answer: A guarantee that only display brightness changes
A need to puncture the battery to cool it
A harmless cosmetic change in every case

fields.scenario: An Event Viewer record shows Kernel-Power event 41 after a restart. What conclusion is justified?
fields.answer: The previous shutdown was unexpected; investigate correlated evidence for the cause

items.detail: Unexpected-shutdown logs are evidence to correlate with other symptoms and records. A shutdown event does not independently identify the root cause.
items.hook: Transfer: What additional evidence would support a power, thermal or driver hypothesis?

answer: The event proves malware caused the restart
The event proves the power supply is faulty
The event proves a specific driver is faulty

topic: Assessment: Remote access, collaboration and AI

fields.scenario: Which default transport/port association is appropriate for direct RDP connectivity?
fields.answer: TCP and UDP 3389

items.detail: Direct RDP commonly uses TCP and UDP port 3389. Gateways and configured ports can change the path; do not assume TCP is its only possible transport.
items.hook: Transfer: How does a Remote Desktop Gateway change the externally exposed path?

answer: TCP 22 as the standard RDP port
UDP 53 as the standard RDP port

fields.scenario: Which line is a conventional comment in a Windows batch file interpreted by cmd.exe?
fields.answer: REM Explain the next step

items.detail: REM records a batch-file comment. Comment syntax depends on the interpreter; PowerShell/Bash and JavaScript examples do not become cmd.exe comments.
items.hook: Transfer: Which interpreter and comment syntax would apply to a .ps1 file?

answer: # Explain the next step as a cmd.exe comment
// Explain the next step as a cmd.exe comment

fields.scenario: A Windows support procedure requires opening the Remote Desktop Connection client. Which command fits?
fields.answer: mstsc.exe

items.detail: mstsc launches the Windows Remote Desktop Connection client. Launching a client does not establish authorization, reachability or permission to control the target.
items.hook: Transfer: Which target, network and permission checks belong before connecting?

fields.scenario: A single remote worker’s device establishes a protected tunnel into the office network. Which model is described?
fields.answer: Remote-access / host-to-site VPN

items.detail: A host-to-site VPN connects an individual remote client to the organization’s network. A VPN does not remove endpoint, authentication or application-authorization requirements.
items.hook: Transfer: How would the diagram change for a branch-office site-to-site VPN?

answer: A replacement for every application login
Only a site-to-site tunnel between two offices

fields.scenario: A team needs a live online meeting with multiple attendees, audio and video. Which capability is the best match?
fields.answer: Videoconferencing in a suitable collaboration platform

items.detail: Videoconferencing is the relevant collaboration capability. Platforms such as Teams/Zoom may also support chat, sharing and other features; one label does not exclude the others.
items.hook: Transfer: Which meeting, sharing and privacy settings should the organizer verify?

answer: Only an offline file checksum utility

fields.scenario: An AI assistant proposes a command that deletes files while troubleshooting. What is the appropriate response?
fields.answer: Verify the command, authorization, backup and consequences before considering execution

items.detail: AI-generated technical guidance needs independent validation and policy review. Confidence and fluent language do not establish accuracy or permission; protect sensitive data.
items.hook: Transfer: How would you test a proposed command using disposable example data?

answer: Run it because a confident explanation proves correctness
Paste secrets into a public service to improve its answer
Assume generated commands cannot cause damage

fields.scenario: For manufacturer-approved servicing of a disconnected PC, which TWO controls directly address ESD handling? (Choose the correct pair.)
fields.answer: Use an approved ESD work surface/mat as directed; Use the approved antistatic wrist strap and connection procedure

items.detail: Approved ESD equipment and handling procedures reduce damaging potential differences. Hair restraint can address other hazards, but it does not replace ESD controls. Follow electrical-safety and equipment guidance.
items.hook: Transfer: Why must the approved servicing procedure be checked before connecting an ESD strap?

answer: Lower humidity as far as possible
Rely on tying hair back as the main ESD control

fields.scenario: A manufacturer’s fastener is a Torx type. Which bit should be selected?
fields.answer: The matching Torx bit and size

items.detail: Use the matching driver type and size to avoid damaging the fastener or equipment. Torx has a familiar six-lobed form; security variants can require a corresponding special bit.
items.hook: Transfer: What should you do when the specified fastener does not match your available tool?

answer: A drill bit chosen without the service procedure
A Phillips bit regardless of fit
Any flat blade forced into the head

fields.scenario: Software offers a limited trial with payment required for continued licensed use. Which familiar licensing description fits?
fields.answer: Shareware / trial software

items.detail: Shareware commonly offers trial or limited use before purchase. Open-source software can be used commercially under its license; price and licensing rights are separate questions.
items.hook: Transfer: Which rights and restrictions would you check before installing software for a business?

answer: Proof that every open-source license forbids commercial use
A guarantee of unlimited licensed use

fields.scenario: Why does an approved ESD wrist-strap cord commonly include a high-resistance safety component?
fields.answer: It limits current while providing the intended controlled discharge path

items.detail: Approved wrist straps commonly include a series safety resistor, often around one megaohm. Use the manufacturer-approved equipment and bonding procedure; this is not a universal instruction for every grounding system.
items.hook: Transfer: Explain why a bare improvised wire is not an equivalent substitute.

answer: It increases the voltage delivered to components

fields.scenario: Before removing dust from equipment, what determines the appropriate PPE and cleaning method?
fields.answer: The task hazards, manufacturer instructions and applicable safety guidance

items.detail: PPE and cleaning methods should match the actual hazard and approved procedure. A filtration mask can be appropriate for airborne particles, but it is not a universal answer for every task.
items.hook: Transfer: How would your preparation change for damaged batteries or hazardous toner?

answer: A rule that every cleaning task always needs exactly the same mask
Whether the technician owns a multimeter
Only the color of the computer case

fields.scenario: Measurements show a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi problem that coincides with a nearby microwave oven operating. Which hypothesis is reasonable to test?
fields.answer: Interference affecting the 2.4 GHz connection

items.detail: Microwave-related interference can affect 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Validate timing, signal and band conditions; this is not a claim that every wireless failure or band has the same cause.
items.hook: Transfer: Design a comparison test that changes one relevant condition at a time.

answer: A universal need to disable encryption
An automatic proof of disk corruption
A guarantee that all Wi-Fi bands are equally affected

fields.scenario: A user is absent and a password is written under the keyboard. What is the appropriate next step before accessing the account?
fields.answer: Use an approved contact/access process and obtain the required authorization

items.detail: Visible credentials do not grant permission to use another person’s account. The approved contact method may be a call, ticket or other channel; texting is not universally required.
items.hook: Transfer: How can an approved support account or supervised session avoid impersonating the user?

answer: Leave the account logged in for convenience
Use the discovered credentials because they are visible

fields.scenario: During a repair, a technician accidentally damages a replacement part. What should the technician do?
fields.answer: Disclose the damage promptly and follow the approved resolution/escalation process

items.detail: Honest communication and documented escalation preserve trust and support safe resolution. Do not conceal damage or continue with a component known to be unsafe or faulty.
items.hook: Transfer: Which ticket and inventory records should be updated?

answer: Hide the incident and close the ticket
Claim it arrived damaged without evidence
Install the visibly damaged part anyway

fields.scenario: A repair will take longer than the estimate already given. Which response is appropriate?
fields.answer: Notify the customer, explain the status and provide a revised realistic estimate

items.detail: Communicate delays and revised expectations proactively. An estimate is not permission to hide risk or mark unfinished work resolved.
items.hook: Transfer: What would you communicate if the next step depends on an uncertain parts delivery?

answer: Close the ticket to meet the original deadline
Remain silent until the customer complains
Promise a time you cannot support

fields.scenario: An organization has configured email-to-ticket intake for users who cannot access its portal. Which method fits this stated situation?
fields.answer: Email the approved support address to create a ticket

items.detail: The correct intake channel follows the organization’s configured and accessible workflow. Email, portals, staff entry and automated alerts have different uses; no one method is universally easiest.
items.hook: Transfer: How would you handle a request containing sensitive data in the ticket body?

answer: Assume email is always easiest in every organization
Bypass all tracking and send credentials to a stranger

fields.scenario: A proposed change must be evaluated away from production and have a recovery path. Which plan fits?
fields.answer: Test in a sandbox, obtain required approval and prepare a backout/rollback plan

items.detail: Sandbox testing isolates evaluation; a backout plan explains how to reverse a failed change. Blackout and backout are different terms. Approval, verification and recovery planning remain part of change control.
items.hook: Transfer: Name a measurable signal that should trigger rollback in a new deployment.

answer: Make the change without recording scope or risk
Treat a blackout period as a rollback procedure
Skip testing because a change is small

fields.scenario: On a supported Windows edition, which interface exposes computer-name and Active Directory domain-membership settings?
fields.answer: System Properties (sysdm.cpl)

items.detail: System Properties provides computer-name/domain membership controls. Successful domain join also requires the correct edition, network/DNS reachability and authorized credentials.
items.hook: Transfer: What would you check if the domain name cannot be resolved?

fields.scenario: A technician wants to inspect signed-in users and their resource activity in Task Manager. Which tab is appropriate?
fields.answer: Users

items.detail: Task Manager’s Users view shows signed-in users and their associated activity. The Performance tab provides resource graphs; it answers a different question.
items.hook: Transfer: Which view would you use to examine GPU utilization rather than user sessions?

answer: Only App history for all interactive sessions

fields.scenario: Which conventional RAID arrangement uses distributed parity, needs at least three drives and tolerates one drive failure?
fields.answer: RAID 5

items.detail: Conventional RAID 5 uses distributed parity and tolerates one member failure. This is supplemental Core 1 storage context. Degraded/rebuild availability depends on the controller and workload; RAID is not backup.
items.hook: Transfer: What happens to redundancy after one failure, and why does a second failure threaten the array?

fields.scenario: After one conventional RAID 5 member fails, what happens to its remaining drive-failure tolerance?
fields.answer: It has no remaining tolerance for another complete member failure until redundancy is restored

items.detail: Conventional RAID 5 has single-member failure tolerance. Recovery and availability depend on the implementation; RAID is not an independent backup.
items.hook: Distinguish availability now from remaining redundancy.

answer: Every RAID 5 array must become permanently inaccessible
